title: The Dark Knight
plot: Batman, Lieutenant Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent form an alliance to dismantle organized crime in Gotham City. Their efforts are undone by the Joker, an anarchist who plunges the city into chaos and pushes Dent into becoming the vengeful Two-Face.

title: Batman Begins
plot: After the murder of his parents, Bruce Wayne trains with the League of Shadows, then returns to Gotham and becomes Batman to fight corruption. He confronts Ra's al Ghul and the Scarecrow, who plan to poison the city with a fear toxin.

title: Man of Steel
plot: Kal-El is sent to Earth as an infant before Krypton's destruction and grows up as Clark Kent. When General Zod arrives to terraform Earth and rebuild Krypton, Clark embraces his identity as Superman to stop him.

title: Wonder Woman
plot: Diana, princess of the Amazons, leaves her hidden island of Themyscira with pilot Steve Trevor during World War I. Believing the war is the work of Ares, she journeys to the front line and discovers the full scope of her powers.

title: Iron Man
plot: Weapons manufacturer Tony Stark is captured in Afghanistan and builds a powered suit of armor to escape. Back home he refines the technology and becomes Iron Man, turning against his business partner Obadiah Stane.

title: The Avengers
plot: Nick Fury assembles Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, the Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye to stop Loki, who uses the Tesseract to open a portal over New York for an alien invasion by the Chitauri.

title: Black Panther
plot: After his father's death, T'Challa returns home to the hidden, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to take the throne. His claim is challenged by Erik Killmonger, who wants to use Wakandan weapons to arm oppressed people worldwide.

title: Spider-Man
plot: High school student Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider and gains superhuman abilities. After his uncle is killed by a robber he let escape, Peter becomes Spider-Man and battles the Green Goblin.

title: Logan
plot: In 2029, an aging and ailing Logan cares for a frail Professor X near the Mexican border. He is drawn back into action to protect Laura, a young mutant girl created from his DNA, from the men hunting her.

title: Deadpool
plot: Mercenary Wade Wilson undergoes a rogue experiment that cures his cancer and leaves him disfigured with accelerated healing. As the wisecracking Deadpool he hunts the man who ruined his life.

title: Joker
plot: Failed stand-up comedian Arthur Fleck, ignored and abused by society in a decaying Gotham City, spirals into violence and madness, eventually adopting the persona that inspires a citywide uprising.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
plot: Peter Quill forms an uneasy alliance with Gamora, Rocket, Groot and Drax to keep a powerful orb out of the hands of Ronan the Accuser, who intends to use it to destroy the planet Xandar.

title: Aquaman
plot: Arthur Curry, the half-human heir to the underwater kingdom of Atlantis, is reluctantly drawn into a conflict when his half-brother Orm tries to unite the seven undersea kingdoms to wage war on the surface world.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
plot: During World War II, frail Steve Rogers volunteers for an experimental super-soldier program and becomes Captain America. He leads the fight against HYDRA and its leader, the Red Skull.

title: The Godfather
plot: The aging patriarch of the Corleone crime family transfers control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son, Michael, who is gradually consumed by the violence and responsibility of the role.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
plot: Banker Andy Dufresne is sentenced to life in Shawshank prison for the murder of his wife, a crime he did not commit. Over two decades he forms a friendship with fellow inmate Red and quietly plans his escape.

title: Inception
plot: Dom Cobb, a thief who steals secrets from within dreams, is offered a chance to have his criminal record erased if he can plant an idea in a target's subconscious through a layered dream heist.

title: Pulp Fiction
plot: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers intertwine in a nonlinear series of violent and darkly comic Los Angeles crime stories.

title: Titanic
plot: In 1912, aristocratic Rose and penniless artist Jack fall in love aboard the doomed ocean liner Titanic on its maiden voyage, only for the ship to strike an iceberg and sink in the North Atlantic.

title: The Matrix
plot: Hacker Neo learns that reality is a simulation created by machines to subdue humanity. Freed by the rebel Morpheus, he trains to fight the Agents and comes to believe he is the prophesied 'One'.

title: Forrest Gump
plot: A slow-witted but kind-hearted man from Alabama inadvertently influences several defining moments of 20th-century American history while pining for his childhood sweetheart, Jenny.

title: Jurassic Park
plot: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park populated by cloned dinosaurs. When the security systems fail during a preview tour, the animals break loose and hunt the visitors.

title: The Lion King
plot: A young lion prince named Simba flees his kingdom after the murder of his father by his uncle Scar. Years later he returns as an adult to reclaim his rightful place as king of the Pride Lands.

title: Gladiator
plot: Roman general Maximus is betrayed when the corrupt Commodus murders his father and seizes the throne. Enslaved and forced to fight as a gladiator, Maximus seeks revenge and the restoration of the Republic.

title: Interstellar
plot: As a blight renders Earth increasingly uninhabitable, former pilot Cooper leads an expedition through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new home for humanity, at the cost of years away from his children.

title: The Departed
plot: An undercover state trooper infiltrates a Boston Irish mob while a mole planted by the same crime boss rises within the police. Each side races to expose the other's informant.

title: Parasite
plot: The impoverished Kim family schemes their way into working for the wealthy Park household by posing as unrelated, qualified professionals, until a hidden secret in the house upends their plan.

title: Whiplash
plot: An ambitious young jazz drummer at an elite conservatory is pushed to the brink by Fletcher, a ruthless instructor who uses abuse and manipulation in his search for greatness.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
plot: In a post-apocalyptic desert, drifter Max is captured by the warlord Immortan Joe and ends up aiding Furiosa, who is fleeing across the wasteland with Joe's five enslaved wives in a war rig.

title: Blade Runner 2049
plot: K, a replicant blade runner for the LAPD, uncovers evidence that a replicant once gave birth. His investigation leads him to Rick Deckard and forces him to question his own origins.

title: No Country for Old Men
plot: A hunter stumbles on the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and takes a satchel of cash, drawing the relentless hitman Anton Chigurh after him while an aging sheriff trails them both.

title: Fight Club
plot: An insomniac office worker and a charismatic soap salesman named Tyler Durden form an underground fight club that evolves into an anti-consumerist militant movement, with a twist about their identities.

title: The Social Network
plot: Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the website that becomes Facebook, and the ensuing success brings lawsuits from his co-founder and from twin classmates who accuse him of stealing their idea.

title: La La Land
plot: In Los Angeles, aspiring actress Mia and jazz pianist Sebastian fall in love while pursuing their creative ambitions, straining their relationship as their careers pull them in different directions.

title: Get Out
plot: A young Black photographer visits the family estate of his white girlfriend and gradually discovers that the unnervingly welcoming household is hiding a sinister plot involving its Black staff.

title: Dune
plot: Paul Atreides and his family are assigned stewardship of the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the spice melange. Betrayed by a rival house, Paul flees into the desert and allies with the native Fremen.

title: The Prestige
plot: Two rival stage magicians in Victorian London become locked in an escalating and destructive obsession to master the ultimate illusion, each willing to sacrifice everything to outdo the other.

title: Arrival
plot: Linguist Louise Banks is recruited to communicate with extraterrestrial visitors whose ships have appeared around the world. Learning their language begins to change how she perceives time.

title: Django Unchained
plot: In the antebellum South, a freed slave named Django partners with a bounty hunter and sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

title: Goodfellas
plot: Henry Hill rises through the ranks of a New York Mafia crew from the 1950s to the 1980s, chronicling the seductions and brutality of mob life until cocaine and paranoia bring it all down.

title: Se7en
plot: Two detectives, a retiring veteran and a hot-headed newcomer, hunt a serial killer who stages elaborate murders around the seven deadly sins.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
plot: FBI trainee Clarice Starling seeks the help of imprisoned cannibal Hannibal Lecter to catch another serial killer, 'Buffalo Bill', who skins his female victims.

title: Back to the Future
plot: Teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back to 1955 in a time-traveling DeLorean built by his friend Doc Brown, where he must ensure his teenage parents fall in love to secure his own existence.

title: Alien
plot: The crew of the commercial towing ship Nostromo answers a distress signal and unwittingly brings aboard a parasitic alien organism that grows and hunts them one by one.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
plot: Concierge Gustave H. and his protege Zero become entangled in the theft of a priceless painting and a battle over a family fortune amid the rising tension of a fictional prewar European state.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
plot: Overwhelmed laundromat owner Evelyn is swept into a multiverse adventure in which she must connect with parallel versions of herself to stop a nihilistic being from destroying all realities.
